summary: thedata ships an opaque OpenSSL-encrypted blob as its sole export
details: The package's `main: index.js` re-exports a single value, `desKey`, from `apps/docs/app/theta.js`. That module's only behavior is to `readFileSync('apps/docs/app/des.db', 'utf8')` and return the string. `des.db` (~49 KB) is base64 of an OpenSSL `Salted__` encrypted blob (contents begin `U2FsdGVkX1/...`). No decryption, execution, network, or filesystem-secret access is present in this package. The package's name and README brand it as the 'Theta Data API' and the bundled `apps/docs/package.json` declares an internal workspace name `thetachain-docs`, resembling the Theta blockchain/data ecosystem. Importing or installing `thedata` does not itself run the encrypted content — a separate loader supplying the decryption key would be required — but the shape (an ecosystem-lookalike package whose only public API is an opaque encrypted blob) is materially unlike any legitimate library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
